ja: • 武将とともに戦場を駆ける騎馬“白銀流星号”がBB戦士にラインナップ • 背に様々な武将（別売）を乗せることが可能 • 手綱はリード線により再現、騎乗した武将に握らせることが可能
en: • The cavalry horse “Shirogane Ryusei” that runs along the battlefield with military commanders is available as a lineup for BB Senshi. • Various military commanders (sold separately) can be mounted on the back. • The reins are reproduced with lead wires and can be held by the mounted military commander.
